comment: Include ONLY the residentialBuilding sources + tests; tsc follows the import graph and typechecks the transitive D-TGL engine (apartmentLayout/tgl/** + emit/score/rules/windowEmission + furnishLayout/style/StyleRegistry) WITHOUT pulling the unrelated AI-relay/executor files that depend on the ai-host root types.
knownEngineErrorsComment: Typecheck against this config reports 9 PRE-EXISTING type-predicate errors in apartmentLayout/tgl/wallsAndDoors.ts (line ~1818, the §WETROOM-PUBLIC-DOOR otherType:string-vs-RoomType narrowing) introduced by the HOUSE commits 78675729 / c7cfcc64 — NOT by P7. That file is a FROZEN tgl/* engine module the parallel agent owns (P7 only CALLS the engine, never edits tgl/*), and tsc cannot skip a type-checked import, so they cannot be suppressed here without editing the forbidden file. The engine still COMPILES + RUNS at runtime (all 48 residential tests pass). On merge this throwaway config is deleted and the @pryzm/ai-host package's own build (which tolerates the engine today) takes over. The residentialBuilding/* P7 sources themselves type-check 100% CLEAN.
